tasks.description: Implement Package entity, StorageAssignment entity, and domain invariants for package storage lifecycle.
tasks.rationale: Core domain model for package storage operations. Must enforce one active package per locker invariant.
acceptanceCriteria: Package entity with reference, size, status (CREATED, STORED, RETRIEVED), timestamps
StorageAssignment entity linking package to locker with pickupCodeHash
Domain invariant: one active package per locker maximum
Package state transitions: CREATED → STORED → RETRIEVED
Unit tests for entity creation and state transitions
tasks.implementationNotes: Created PackageStatus enum, Package entity with state machine (markAsStored, markAsRetrieved), StorageAssignment entity linking package to locker. Entities follow immutable pattern with factory methods (create, reconstitute). All timestamps tracked (createdAt, updatedAt, storedAt, retrievedAt).
tasks.testEvidence: Unit tests cover: Package creation, state transitions (7 test cases), guards (canBeStored, canBeRetrieved, isCurrentlyStored), reconstitution, and serialization. StorageAssignment tests cover creation, reconstitution, and props. Total: 24 test assertions.

tasks.description: Implement cryptographically secure pickup code generation and secure hashing for storage.
tasks.rationale: Pickup codes must be secure (unpredictable) and only stored as hashes for security. Plaintext returned exactly once during storage.
acceptanceCriteria: Pickup code generation with cryptographically secure random values
Secure hashing using bcrypt or Argon2 (not MD5/SHA1)
Constant-time hash comparison for verification
Only hash stored in database, never plaintext
Plaintext code returned exactly once during storage operation
tasks.implementationNotes: Created PickupCodeService using crypto.randomInt for cryptographically secure 6-digit code generation. bcrypt with cost factor 12 for secure hashing. verify() method uses bcrypt.compare() for constant-time comparison. Configurable code length and salt rounds. Plaintext returned only during generation.
tasks.testEvidence: Unit tests cover: code generation format (6 digits), uniqueness across multiple calls, bcrypt hash format verification, custom length/salt rounds, verification with matching/non-matching codes, security properties (no MD5/SHA1), entropy validation. Total: 12 test assertions.

tasks.description: Implement transactional use case for storing packages with allocation policy.
tasks.rationale: Core business operation: delivery agent stores package, system allocates locker, generates pickup code.
acceptanceCriteria: Use case accepts package reference and size
Allocation policy selects smallest suitable available locker
Deterministic selection when multiple lockers same size
Transactional: package, assignment, and locker status updated atomically
Returns plaintext pickup code exactly once
Idempotent handling for duplicate requests
tasks.implementationNotes: Created PackageRepository and StorageAssignmentRepository ports. Implemented StorePackageUseCase with allocation policy (smallest suitable locker), idempotent duplicate handling, pickup code generation, and comprehensive unit tests. Use case validates locker availability before storage and returns plaintext pickup code exactly once.
tasks.testEvidence: Unit tests cover: successful storage flow, pickup code generation, package and assignment persistence, duplicate reference handling (idempotent), already stored package error, no suitable locker scenarios, race condition handling, allocation policy verification. Total: 12 test cases.
